en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a coastal resort with sand dunes, a beach promenade and pier, wooded hills in the background, and several large seaside villas or hotels. In the foreground a man with a cane and a woman in long dress walk along a sandy path. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the location as Binz on the island of Rügen and mentions Villa Agnes and Hotel Seeschloss. Publisher information is printed along the lower edge.
